reading.zh: 从左到右是运行时的依赖方向：平台挂载一切，包与定义提供数据，枪械与弹道是玩法，模型/渲染/光学是表现，护甲与客户端界面在各层之上。
reading.en: Left to right follows the runtime dependency direction: the platform mounts everything, packs and definitions supply data, guns and ballistics are gameplay, models/rendering/optics are presentation, armour and the client UI sit on top.
